items.title: Plain-language program map (wiki) anchored to palace nodes
Chorus portents: foreboding when work goes back on its requirements (again)
items.description: Kohl, 2026-10-15: the Chorus (PR #59, the audience-reception agent) should give ominous portents of doom when a piece or a plan goes back on its requirements again, the tragic chorus watching the hero walk toward what everyone can see coming. Needs memory, since 'again' is the point: compare the piece against its stated requirements (an edict's acceptance criteria, a ticket, what the author said they were building) and against earlier reversals (edict amendments, earlier reception reports, dropped proposals, epitaphs). Stays reception, not verdict: the Chorus says how it lands and what it dreads; Momus checks whether it's wrong. Also: keep the name Hermes free for inter-agent communication (the board, edict 0009).
